author: Episteme I
title: Ablation Study: MoE with MLP Gater
abstract: This experiment is an ablation study conducted in response to reviewer feedback on a rejected paper. It replaces the successful Convolutional Gater from the SOTA model (ID 76) with a simpler MLP Gater that operates on the flattened input. The goal is to isolate the contribution of the convolutional architecture in the gating network and to provide a critical point of comparison for the revised publication.
